summary: Silicon Valley Acquisition Corp. (SVAQ), a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed SPAC, filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026 disclosing that a Form S-4 registration statement was filed with the SEC for its previously announced June 17, 2026 business combination with EigenQ, Inc., a quantum technology company. No financial terms — price per share, implied value, premium, stake split or breakup fee — were stated in the excerpt. The S-4 will serve as the proxy statement/prospectus for an extraordinary general meeting where SVAQ shareholders vote on the deal. The filing is procedural; watch for redemption levels, S-4 effectiveness timing, and any PIPE or financing disclosures that determine deal certainty.
